rcomp.steuerung: Drag left: steer · swipe right or ▲ ▼: gait

regeln.springen: Ride the course in order and jump every obstacle (Space or the Jump button). A knockdown costs 40 points, a refusal 20 — every second over the target time costs 5. Perfect take-offs earn +15!
regeln.dressur: Follow the glowing line through all figures and hold the required gait. The closer to the ideal line, the more points. Switch gaits exactly on the signal for the rhythm bonus!
regeln.gelaende: Across the meadow: ride through all flag gates in order to the finish. Every skipped gate costs 8 seconds. Manage your stamina wisely!
regeln.rennen: 3 laps on the turf track against the field. Tuck into the slipstream of the horse ahead (+3% speed) and overtake on the straight. The finishing order counts!
regeln.trail: 6 precision tasks: ride slowly and cleanly through every marker. Each touch costs 2 points, skipping costs all 10. Quick AND clean earns the time bonus.
regeln.schau: All about splendor: your horse's grooming and mood, your gear style — and the freestyle! Tap the 5 commands right on the beat (±300 ms).
regeln.tonnen: Cloverleaf pattern: round the right, the left and the far barrel, then race back to the start. A toppled barrel costs 5 seconds!
